verses.en: Help, LORD; for the godly man ceaseth; for the faithful fail from among the children of men.
verses.pt: Salva-nos, Senhor, pois não existe mais o piedoso; os fiéis desapareceram dentre os filhos dos homens.
verses.en_web: Help, Yahweh; for the godly man ceases. For the faithful fail from among the children of men.
verses.en_bbe: <For the chief music-maker on the Sheminith. A Psalm. Of David.> Send help, Lord, for mercy has come to an end; there is no more faith among the children of men.

verses.en: They speak vanity every one with his neighbour: with flattering lips and with a double heart do they speak.
verses.pt: Cada um fala com falsidade ao seu próximo; falam com lábios lisonjeiros e coração dobre.
verses.en_web: Everyone lies to his neighbor. They speak with flattering lips, and with a double heart.
verses.en_bbe: Everyone says false words to his neighbour: their tongues are smooth in their talk, and their hearts are full of deceit.

verses.en: The LORD shall cut off all flattering lips, and the tongue that speaketh proud things:
verses.pt: Corte o Senhor todos os lábios lisonjeiros e a língua que fala soberbamente,
verses.en_web: May Yahweh cut off all flattering lips, and the tongue that boasts,
verses.en_bbe: The smooth lips and the tongue of pride will be cut off by the Lord.

verses.en: Who have said, With our tongue will we prevail; our lips are our own: who is lord over us?
verses.pt: os que dizem: Com a nossa língua prevaleceremos; os nossos lábios a nós nos pertecem; quem sobre nós é senhor?
verses.en_web: who have said, “With our tongue we will prevail. Our lips are our own. Who is lord over us?”
verses.en_bbe: They have said, With our tongues will we overcome; our lips are ours: who is lord over us?

verses.en: For the oppression of the poor, for the sighing of the needy, now will I arise, saith the LORD; I will set him in safety from him that puffeth at him.
verses.pt: Por causa da opressão dos pobres, e do gemido dos necessitados, levantar-me-ei agora, diz o Senhor; porei em segurança quem por ela suspira.
verses.en_web: “Because of the oppression of the weak and because of the groaning of the needy, I will now arise,” says Yahweh; “I will set him in safety from those who malign him.”
verses.en_bbe: Because of the crushing of the poor and the weeping of those in need, now will I come to his help, says the Lord; I will give him the salvation which he is desiring.

verses.en: The words of the LORD are pure words: as silver tried in a furnace of earth, purified seven times.
verses.pt: As palavras do Senhor são palavras puras, como prata refinada numa fornalha de barro, purificada sete vezes.
verses.en_web: Yahweh’s words are flawless words, as silver refined in a clay furnace, purified seven times.
verses.en_bbe: The words of the Lord are true words: like silver tested by fire and burned clean seven times.

verses.en: Thou shalt keep them, O LORD, thou shalt preserve them from this generation for ever.
verses.pt: Guarda-nos, ó Senhor; desta geração defende-nos para sempre.
verses.en_web: You will keep them, Yahweh. You will preserve them from this generation forever.
verses.en_bbe: You will keep them, O Lord, you will keep them safe from this generation for ever.

verses.en: The wicked walk on every side, when the vilest men are exalted.
verses.pt: Os ímpios andam por toda parte, quando a vileza se exalta entre os filhos dos homens.
verses.en_web: The wicked walk on every side, when what is vile is exalted among the sons of men.
verses.en_bbe: The sinners are walking on every side, and evil is honoured among the children of men.
